scope: Publication-only static review; the numeric audit is recorded separately in artifact_validation.json.
excluded: Model weights, full Q/K/V traces, environment/cache, private setup logs and Korean review report.
included: English methods/code, synthetic inputs (including Korean text), frozen specification, raw per-unit/row metrics, figures, model/environment provenance and a small development fixture.
